newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian railwaymen postpone threatened strike.
newsitem.headline: Indian railwaymen postpone threatened strike.

text.p: Indian railway employees in Bombay who planned to go on a day's strike over a wage dispute on June 11 said on Tuesday they had decided to postpone their action.
Representatives of the agitating railwayman said they would wait for further negotiations with a senior official of India's Railway Board.

"We will wait till June 12 for the discussion," N. Haridas, divisional secretary of the National Railway Mazdoor Union (NRMU), told reporters. "If that meeting does not materialise we will immediately go on strike."
The NRMU represents about 700 motormen on Bombay's suburban railway network.
The motormen are protesting what they describe as anomalies in revised pay scales planned by the federal government which they fear would be unfair to them if implemented.
